name: Full two-step approval deducts the balance and shows Approved everywhere

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.full@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Leave Balance' page via the sidebar link (URL /balances).
The 'Annual Leave' balance card shows '12/12' and the text '0 of 12 day(s) used this year'.
Open the 'New Request' page (URL /requests/create), select 'Annual Leave', set Start date to 2026-11-03 and End date to 2026-11-05, enter reason 'E2E balance marker' and click 'Submit request'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Supervisor Queue' page (URL /approvals/supervisor), find the row for employee 'Flow Full' with reason 'E2E balance marker', click 'Approve' and confirm in the dialog.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'HR Queue' page (URL /hr/approvals), find the row for employee 'Flow Full' with reason 'E2E balance marker', click 'Approve' and confirm in the dialog.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.full@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
The 'Annual Leave' balance card now shows '9/12' and the text '3 of 12 day(s) used this year'.
The 'E2E balance marker' request shows the status 'Approved'.
